verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's CLI (hopp test) explicitly runs collections as automated test suites and generates JUnit reports for pass/fail reporting, and docs describe using it for automated monitoring/CI integration; collections support tests/pre-request scripts per gh-5/docs-20/docs-37. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report validating CLI test-run reliability at scale, and no explicit mention of a native pass/fail summary UI in the web app itself.
